baseline.policy: Use the current broad-universe EPS-surprise-only PEAD candidate policy with its frozen universe, ranking, entry clock, notional, costs and exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing PEAD candidate slot, issuer positive-contribution concentration below 40%, and no production allocation
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commissions and slippage at identical notional; no financing credit
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: CAT common stock only for the current lead; no option, leverage, inverse product or proxy mapping
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical equity liquidity, gap-cancel and stale-price controls must pass at the next regular-session open
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: The earnings event, consensus snapshot, backlog, dealer inventory, adjusted-margin reconciliation and signal-day close must all be known before the entry open

falsifier: Reject or park if the current-quarter primary fields are absent at the decision clock, if historical values are not canonical as-known, if any standard window has fewer than five independent executable touches, if no valid novelty axis survives prior fingerprints, if the fixed bundle adds no H10 and H20 replacement value over unconditioned PEAD and cash/SPY/QQQ after costs, or if positive contribution is concentrated above 40% in one issuer.
hypothesis: For broad-universe positive PEAD candidates, post-earnings drift may be more durable when source-dated firm backlog growth exceeds dealer-inventory build and adjusted operating margin declines no more than 100 basis points year over year; the current CAT lead must be evaluated only after every input is known at the next regular-session open over fixed H10 and H20 replacement value versus cash, SPY, QQQ and unconditioned PEAD.
replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, and the exact unconditioned PEAD candidate at the same universe, slot, entry clock, notional, costs and exit policy.
title: CAT PEAD operating-quality conversion lead

treatment.policy: Keep the baseline unchanged but admit a candidate only when latest EPS surprise is at least 10%, firm backlog change minus dealer-inventory change is above zero, and consistently defined adjusted operating margin year-over-year change is at least minus 100 basis points; enter only at the first regular-session open after all inputs are known and evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons.

why_not_arbitraged: EPS surprise is public and the signal-day price may already absorb the headline. Any residual edge must come from source-dated operating-quality conversion that is not captured by consensus or price, and it must survive PIT, touch-density, source-overlap, concentration and exact opportunity-cost tests.
